name: Vought F4U-1D Corsair
blurb: The game's original Blender Corsair, built from cited dimensions with an inverted gull wing, moving gear, propeller and control surfaces.
history:
The Vought F4U Corsair was designed as a carrier fighter and entered service in large numbers with the U.S. Navy and Marine Corps. Early trouble with carrier landings sent it first to land-based Marine and Navy squadrons, and the Grumman F6F Hellcat, which used the same Double Wasp engine, became the dominant carrier fighter instead.

What this entry models: an original Blender model of the F4U-1D (span 41 ft 0 in, length 33 ft 8 in, 3-bladed propeller), with every figure the sources do not give labeled as an estimate in its script. It is the model used in flight; the retired download remains in the DEV Hangar.

sources.title: F4U-1D Detail Specification, Report No. 6756 (Chance Vought, 15 Feb 1945)
FG-1A Production Inspection Trials, TED BIS 2122 (NAS Patuxent River, 1944)
